      Nice guys and a thorough company but getting a quote does not need to come with a REMOVEDtalk. They showed up we explained that our evening changed and we not longer had a lot of time.     • Review fromWilla M

      Date: 09/10/2026

      1 star
      Dabella updated my shower the way they wanted it done not how we wanted it done. They built a solid wall instead of swapping out old glass wall and putting in new glass wall. They wanted to install sliding glass shower door when we wanted a new hinged shower door. We stopped the work and while waiting they left open construction in our shower area for 20 days even after multiple requests to have it covered. They told us we needed the solid wall to anchor seat so they took down half the wall and said they would give us contact information for a different installer who didn't work for them to install half glass wall and hinged door. We also thought we were getting tile since we looked at and selected a style and color. There was a breach of contract and scope of work on contract was general and we asked for specific details and itemized invoice showing what we were paying for but never received it. They say they are done and will give us $2000 credit to hire someone to put in glass materials and if goes over we are responsible. Don't let the BBB A+rating fool you. Do a deep dive.
